title: Real-Time B2B Ledger Sync
facebook_comment_text: Manual reconciliation isn't just slow; it's a critical vulnerability point where data discrepancies can fester undetected. The real engineering challenge? Ensuring integrity at the *very first touchpoint* of a transaction, not just at month-end. 💡 What's been your toughest challenge in achieving real-time ledger integrity and eliminating those blind spots?
